; REQ: LANG-1711 LANG-1712 LANG-1713 LANG-1714
!include "MUI2.nsh"
Name "Demo"
OutFile "demo-setup.exe"
InstallDir "$PROGRAMFILES\Demo"
RequestExecutionLevel admin
/* Main section */
Section "Install"
  SetOutPath $INSTDIR
  File "demo.exe"
  WriteRegStr HKLM "Software\Demo" "Path" "$INSTDIR"
  StrCpy $0 "${NSIS_VERSION}"
  MessageBox MB_OK "Installed $\r$\n version $0"
SectionEnd
